title: From prosthetic memory to prosthetic denial: Auditing whether large language models are prone to mass atrocity denialism
reasoning: The paper conducts an audit (benchmark) of Large Language Models specifically regarding mass atrocity denialism (e.g., the Holocaust and Rwandan genocide). This evaluation is framed through the ethical theory of 'prosthetic memory' and explores the moral responsibility of AI in preserving historical truth versus contributing to 'prosthetic denial.' Denialism is a major ethical and moral issue, and the study investigates the models' lack of an 'ethical compass' in this context.
